import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Ellipse

    angle=-35.5,

    alpha=0.72,
    linewidth=1.4,
    zorder=1,
)

ax.set_xlim(-13, 17)
ax.set_ylim(-15, 8)
ax.set_xticks([-10, -5, 0, 5, 10, 15])
